assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is medically necessary
The payer's denial code CO-97 states that payment for this service is bundled into another covered procedure
separate reimbursement is not permitted under current policy guidelines
